get.description: ADMIN only. Adds data.line_monopolies ordered by line_number. Each row retains numeric earned_score and adds earned_score_exact as a fixed two-decimal string for full Decimal(20,2) precision.

200.description: Existing team detail with line_monopolies, including an empty array when none are owned

patch.description: ADMIN only. Existing numeric values remain accepted. Exact decimal strings are also accepted without an intermediate binary float conversion.

200.description: Adds data.earned_score_exact while retaining the numeric earned_score field

400.description: Invalid line, unowned line, invalid score or missing reason

get.description: ADMIN only. Adds data.capabilities.recording_supported and dispatch_supported as booleans, including when the catalog is empty. Reading never records or dispatches a publication request.

200.description: Existing paginated request catalog with capabilities

get.description: ADMIN only. Adds data.activation, null when no activation intent exists, otherwise the latest nonempty activation record. Fields: request_id, release_id, status, operation_status, last_error_code. It does not expose preparation specs or secrets.

200.description: Release catalog with latest activation intent; GET never advances the current release
